## Empowering a sustainable future for our planet

Agilent supports more than 285,000 laboratories across 110 countries—advancing scientific discovery
and innovation on a global scale.

The Agilent Foundation partners with organizations that advance STEM education, promote global
wellbeing, and build climate resilience.

Agilent is advancing science with purpose—embedding circular economy principles to drive sustainable
innovation and long-term impact.

Agilent is deepening its collaboration with My Green Lab as a top-tier Transformative Sponsor, while
expanding our portfolio of ACT-labeled products to support more sustainable science.

# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og
aktive byrom på bakkeplan.

Du bor tett på byliv, kollektivtilbud, butikker og servering, med Akerselva i umiddelbar nærhet.
Leilighetene varierer i størrelse og er tilpasset ulike livsfaser, med fokus på gode planløsninger
og hverdagskvaliteter. Salget av leilighetene er nå i gang.

[Les mer om Valseverket her][18]

[][19]

## [Kystbyen Slemmestad][20]

I Kystbyen Slemmestad vokser det snart frem et levende nabolag og bysentrum. Her blir det 1300
boliger og et rikt kultur- og servicetilbud. Her vil du ha alt du trenger for å bo, leve, dele og
oppleve – med nærhet til sjø, natur, og alt som trengs for å leve et komfortabelt og aktivt liv!
[Les mer om Slemmestad her.][21]

 

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

# [Vi gjør alt][25]
# [for byens beste][26]

Det betyr også å gjøre det beste for våre kunder og alle deres ansatte. Vi er en av landets mest
erfarne eiendomsforvaltere og håndterer i dag mer enn 330.000 kvadratmeter eiendom. [Les mer om
drift og forvaltning her][27].

[][28]
[][29]
[][30]

## Prosjekter

## →

## [Velkommen til Vertikal Nydalen][31]

Et bygg som kan ta pusten fra de fleste og arbeidsdagen til et helt nytt nivå!

[Les mer her][32]

## Aktuelt

## [Bevarer industribygg og skaper en ny bydel på Slemmestad][33]

Bevarer industribygg og skaper en ny bydel på Slemmestad PRESSEMELDING: Avantor har nå ferdigstilt
planforslaget for den store Fabrikktomta på Slemmestad. Slemmestad 09.03.25 – Avantor har nå
ferdigstilt planforslaget for den store Fabrikktomta på Slemmestad....

## [Åpnet ny hurtigbåtkai på Slemmestad][34]

Åpnet ny hurtigbåtkai på Slemmestad PRESSEMELDING: 2. februar 2026 ble den nye hurtigbåtkaia på
Slemmestad offisielt åpnet med snorklipping av ordfører, Lene Conradi. Slemmestad 02.02.26 – Asker
kommune har investert flere titalls millioner i ny hurtigbåtkai på...

## [REBUS kjøper eiendom av Avantor i Slemmestad][35]

REBUS kjøper eiendom av Avantor i Slemmestad PRESSEMELDING: Avantor har solgt et delområde innenfor
prosjektet Kystbyen Slemmestad til REBUS.  Slemmestad/Oslo 01.12.25 – Avantor har solgt et delområde
innenfor prosjektet Kystbyen Slemmestad til REBUS. Eiendommen...

# Salgsstart Valseverket

I hjertet av Nydalen kommer Valseverket – et nytt boligprosjekt med 152 leiligheter i varige
kvaliteter. Her legges det til rette for et levende bymiljø, med grønne takhager, gode uteområder og
aktive byrom på bakkeplan.

Du bor tett på byliv, kollektivtilbud, butikker og servering, med Akerselva i umiddelbar nærhet.
Leilighetene varierer i størrelse og er tilpasset ulike livsfaser, med fokus på gode planløsninger
og hverdagskvaliteter. Salget av leilighetene er nå i gang.

[Les mer om Valseverket her][18]

[][19]

## [Kystbyen Slemmestad][20]

I Kystbyen Slemmestad vokser det snart frem et levende nabolag og bysentrum. Her blir det 1300
boliger og et rikt kultur- og servicetilbud. Her vil du ha alt du trenger for å bo, leve, dele og
oppleve – med nærhet til sjø, natur, og alt som trengs for å leve et komfortabelt og aktivt liv!
[Les mer om Slemmestad her.][21]

 

## [«*Det beste for byen er også det beste for oss*»][22]

Hvorfor Elkjøp, ice og noen av de største selskapene i Norge er kunder hos Avantor? [Få svaret fra
noen av våre fornøyde kunder her][23].

## Miljøprosjektet Nydalen
## – fra nedlagt industri til yrende liv

Historien om Nydalen er like mangslungen som elven den ligger ved. Den forteller om et område preget
av skog, senere tungindustri, så tomme fabrikkhaller og som nå yrer av liv igjen.

Siden tidlig på 90-tallet har Avantor vært den største bydelsutvikleren i Nydalen. For å skape en
grønn og moderne bydel, satte vi miljøstrategi øverst på agendaen. [Les mer om det vi har gjort for
Nydalen her][24].

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

### Serving life sciences from early research to commercial manufacturing

[

## Who We Are

Your life sciences journey deserves a partner that scales with you. ATS Life Sciences Group connects
discovery, process, and production into one seamless workflow—from early R&D to full commercial
manufacturing. Our integrated ecosystem combines proven life sciences technologies and
future-focused automation to ensure quality, consistency, and cost savings at every step.

**We earn our customers’ trust through consistency and dependability. **

[Learn More][21]

## life sciences journey

## Why Life Sciences Group

#### Expertise

Our proven insights ensure that no matter where you are in your journey, we can support your needs.

#### Innovation

We foster innovation by turning bold ideas into practical solutions that position our customers for
success.

#### Integration

We integrate systems seamlessly, delivering the power of unified skill and collaboration.

#### Reliability

We earn trust through consistency, accuracy, and compliance when it matters most

#### Quality

Our solutions consistently exceed expectations, ensuring lasting value and performance.

#### Service

From proactive maintenance to hands-on training, we deliver responsive service that maximizes asset
performance.

## Our Businesses

Life Sciences Group is a collection of six specialized  businesses  each contributing unique
expertise. Together, we provide a global ecosystem of solutions, serving customers across more than
20 countries with over 40 facilities and 3,750 employees.

# [125712-01 vs 149986-02 Differences for Bently Nevada 3500/32 4-Channel Relay Module][5]

[**Bently Nevada 3500/32**][6] 4-Channel Relay Module stands as a critical component in asset
condition monitoring systems, translating critical alarm signals into actionable responses to
protect your most valuable equipment.





A 3500 relay module is a multi-channel module composed of a main card known as the relay controller
and a relay output module. The relay controller interfaces with the 3500 system alarming network to
process its configured relay drive logic and generate relay channel drive signals. The relay I/O
module accepts the relay drive signals from the controller and contains the relay devices which
provide the machinery trip contacts.





3500/32 main card ordering number is **125712-01**,the upgrade 3500/32M ordering number is
149986-02. What’s the difference? Is the new code 149986-02 can replace of 125712-01?



125712-01 is built to match its exact OEM specs—epoxy-sealed construction, 250 Vrms arc suppressor,
and relay contacts rated for 100,000 cycles at 5 A, 24 Vdc/120 Vac. It’s a drop-in fit for the 3500
rack’s full-height front slot, requiring no reconfiguration for legacy setups. 149986-02 is the
dedicated spare for the upgraded 3500/32M, designed to support its enhanced features, including SIL
2 functional safety and ATEX/IECEx hazardous area certifications, plus expanded input compatibility
for Not-OK and PPL signals alongside standard alarm inputs.



Software and firmware compatibility further set them apart. 125712-01 works with older 3500 Rack
Configuration Software versions, needing no minimum rev levels for seamless integration—ideal for
facilities that haven’t upgraded their system software. 149986-02 has strict prerequisites: it
requires the 3500/22 TDI module (Rev 1.71+ firmware), 3500 Rack Configuration Software (Rev 4.5+),
and compatible display module firmware, ensuring the 3500/32M’s advanced logic and safety features
function as intended.





Their use cases diverge too: 125712-01 suits standard non-hazardous industrial environments where
the original 3500/32’s core alarm logic is sufficient, a cost-effective direct replacement for basic
setups. [**149986-02**][7] is built for high-stakes applications—hazardous areas, marine systems
(DNV GL/ABS certified), and functional safety setups—where the 3500/32M’s regulatory compliance and
upgraded performance are mandatory.

## Lab Automation

Lab automation has been pivotal to enhancing research efficiency and accuracy, and BICO brands stand
at the forefront of its development. With high-quality and reliable lab automation technology,
scientists are relieved from the labor-intensive, time-consuming tasks, allowing them to focus on
the science and achieve greater productivity than ever before.

Beyond improving efficiency, automated labs generate standardized, high-quality data, creating a
foundation for artificial intelligence and machine learning applications. This structured data
enables smarter insights, predictive modeling, and data-driven decision-making across research and
development.

Lab automation is for labs of all sizes, done at all scales. BICO builds and offers solutions at all
scales, from standalone automation and workflow automation to end-to-end lab automation.

## Lab Automation

Lab automation has been pivotal to enhancing research efficiency and accuracy, and BICO brands stand
at the forefront of its development. With high-quality and reliable lab automation technology,
scientists are relieved from the labor-intensive, time-consuming tasks, allowing them to focus on
the science and achieve greater productivity than ever before.

Beyond improving efficiency, automated labs generate standardized, high-quality data, creating a
foundation for artificial intelligence and machine learning applications. This structured data
enables smarter insights, predictive modeling, and data-driven decision-making across research and
development.

Lab automation is for labs of all sizes, done at all scales. BICO builds and offers solutions at all
scales, from standalone automation and workflow automation to end-to-end lab automation.

## *About Us*

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

## *About Us*

## *About Us*

Founded in 1999, BIOBASE is a professional manufacturer whose business covers laboratory equipment,
medical device, engineering project and cosmetics. With more than 3,000 employees, 25+ factories,
BIOBASE has established overseas branches in USA, UAE, Singapore, Kazakhstan, India and other
countries. BIOBASE has long-term business partners in 190+ countries. BIOBASE can provide one-stop
solutions for laboratory and medical fields. Main products include biological safety cabinet,
laminar flow cabinet, fume hood, refrigerator & freezer, autoclave, oven, incubator, centrifuge,
wheel chair, hospital bed, IVD instrument, clean room project, etc. BIOBASE has certificates
including ISO9001, ISO13485, ISO14001, ISO45001, FDA, NSF49, EN12469, MET, CE, ETL, etc. BIOBASE
would like to establish win-win business cooperation with distributors all over the world.

# Supporting scientists for the sake of science

## We exist to do whatever it takes to empower scientists to do their best work

Calibre Scientific Group is a diversified, global life sciences company with the goal of empowering
scientists by providing the high-quality products, services, and support they need.

[Learn more about us][39]
80,000+

market-leading products & services

18,000+

healthcare, diagnostics & life sciences customers

175

countries served

## Empowering Science®

The potential of science to improve every aspect of life grows stronger with each experiment, each
discovery, each breakthrough. The effects of scientific success are far-reaching, and the scientists
committed to driving that success are nothing short of incredible.

By equipping scientists with solutions to help remove unnecessary obstacles—made by people with a
firsthand understanding of what they are—we’re **empowering science. **And that benefits us all.

## Our businesses

Calibre Scientific Group's integrated platform includes three businesses that make up a
discovery-to-delivery solution serving a diversified customer base of pharmaceutical and industrial
companies, universities, hospitals, and reference labs.

[Explore Businesses][40]
[[Calibre Lab]][41]
Distribution Business

Distribution platform providing specialized products, robust sourcing capabilities, and responsive
support from experts.

[[Calibre Scientific]][42]
Proprietary Products Business

Leader in providing high-quality custom and off-the-shelf solutions, supported by technical experts,
for life sciences customers doing specialized applications.

[[Calibre Tec Service Division]][43]
Service Business

Dependable services across the full product lifecycle, including calibration and validation;
technical support and consulting; equipment installation and maintenance; and testing, inspection,
and measurement.

## World-class leadership

Senior Vice President, People & Culture
][48]

Our executive leadership team leverages extensive experience in life sciences and diagnostics to
deliver innovative solutions, foster collaborative partnerships, and consistently meet the evolving
needs of customers and suppliers worldwide.

[Meet Our Team][49]
[[Logo]][50]

Calibre Scientific Group is a diversified, global developer, manufacturer, and distributor of
proprietary, market-leading solutions for specialized applications in the healthcare,
pharmaceutical, diagnostics, and life sciences industries. Its preeminent, integrated platform spans
three business lines: Calibre Scientific, provider of proprietary manufactured products; Calibre
Lab, provider of distribution products; and Calibre Tec, a service and support business.

# Making sure you're not a bot!

Loading...

You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the
server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause
downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.

Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed
proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional
load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.

Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and
identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of
work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.

Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter
will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.

Sadly, you must enable JavaScript to get past this challenge. This is required because AI companies
have changed the social contract around how website hosting works. A no-JS solution is a
work-in-progress.

Protected by [BotStopper][1] From [Techaro][2]. Made with ❤️ in 🇨🇦.

# Making sure you're not a bot!

Loading...

You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the
server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause
downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.

Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed
proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional
load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.

Ultimately, this is a placeholder solution so that more time can be spent on fingerprinting and
identifying headless browsers (EG: via how they do font rendering) so that the challenge proof of
work page doesn't need to be presented to users that are much more likely to be legitimate.

Please note that Anubis requires the use of modern JavaScript features that plugins like JShelter
will disable. Please disable JShelter or other such plugins for this domain.

Sadly, you must enable JavaScript to get past this challenge. This is required because AI companies
have changed the social contract around how website hosting works. A no-JS solution is a
work-in-progress.

Protected by [BotStopper][1] From [Techaro][2]. Made with ❤️ in 🇨🇦.

## Welcome to Esco Lifesciences!
## A world-leading manufacturer and service provider of life science tools

Esco Lifesciences is a world-leading life science company with a diversified portfolio and sales in
over 100 countries. As a manufacturer of laboratory and biopharma equipment, and IVF medical
devices, Esco offers tailored solutions that fit the needs of laboratories in various industries.

Esco Lifesciences contributes to meet the challenges of the 21st century with a diverse range of
business units. The company continuously innovates its products to help the clinical and industrial
laboratories achieve successful conclusions in research and development, quality control, and
analysis. We continue to provide reliable world-class equipment to help pharmaceutical companies
make their products safer and more cost-effective. And with the increasing demand of the IVF
industry, we have developed efficient ART equipment to enable equitable access to infertility care.

### [STEM CELL BIOLOGY][60]

Explore how stem cells self-renew and differentiate into specialized cell types, supporting tissue
regeneration, development, and the maintenance of healthy biological systems.

[Read more >][61]
[3D render of clustered spherical cells illustrating stem cell aggregation and self-renewal in
tissue regeneration]

### [IMMUNO-ONCOLOGY &
### IMMUNOTHERAPY][62]

Learn how the immune system detects and eliminates cancer cells using antibodies, immune
checkpoints, and engineered immunotherapies.

[Read more >][63]
[3D render of an antibody binding to a tumor cell cluster, depicting targeted immunotherapy in
immuno-oncology.]

### [AUTOPHAGY][64]

See how cells recycle damaged proteins and organelles through autophagy, a critical process that
maintains cellular balance and supports survival under stress conditions.

[Read more >][65]
[3D cross-section of a cell revealing intracellular vesicles and organelles undergoing autophagic
degradation.]

### [NANOMATERIALS][66]

Discover how nanoscale materials interact with biological systems to enable targeted drug delivery,
advanced diagnostics, and innovative therapeutic technologies.

[Read more >][67]
[3D render of a hollow geodesic nanostructure illustrating nanomaterial scaffolding for targeted
drug delivery.]

### [METASTASIS][68]

Explore how tumor cells spread from a primary site to distant organs, the barriers circulating tumor
cells face in establishing metastases, and why metastatic disease is associated with poor prognosis.

[Read more >][69]
[3D render of a tumor cell mass with projecting extensions, illustrating invasive metastatic
dissemination.]

### [THE CELL CYCLE][70]

Learn how the cell cycle phases (G1, S, G2, M), checkpoints, and regulators such as cyclins and
cyclin-dependent kinases control cell proliferation and maintain genomic integrity.

[Read more >][71]
[3D render of a four-cell embryo illustrating early-stage cleavage and cell division in
developmental biology.]

## SPECIAL OFFER

## PARTNERING PHILOSOPHY

At ILS, we create partnership that are based on shared visions, values, knowledge & expertise. This
sharing adds value for each partner and paves the way to developing breakthrough scientifc
innovations, providing solutions for unmet research needs. Our goal is to provide the perfect
solution with every partner with whom we work.

## TESTIMONIALS

### Dr Amit Tuli, Senior Scientist, CSIR-IMTECH

“The customer service support at Imperial Life Sciences is one of the best support I have received
from any company in India who deals in R&D products. The ILS team is very professional when it comes
to providing solutions to technical or sale queries for the R&D products. Their dedicated sales and
technical staff is very approachable and they do a great job in handling customers concerns or
queries. I highly recommend ILS for purchase of R&D products”

### Dr. VGM Naidu, M.Tech, Ph.D.

“Greetings from NIPER Guwahati Happy to further support ILS due to the Quick services and best
quality products “

### Dr. Aparna Dixit , Professor

"Just wanted to say that ILS provides excellent appreciable service and quick cordial support with
best customer assistance”

## NEWS & EVENTS

## [Immunocon 2019][241]

46th Annual Conference of Indian Immunology Society IMMUNOCON 2019

## [NCCB&T 2019][242]

National Conference on Cancer Biology & Therapeutics Nov. 29-30, 2019,

## [EMSI 2018][243]

Annual Conference of Environmental Mutagen Society of India (EMSI) & National Conference on
"Integration of Basic Biology & Omics to improve Human Health”.

## [ICCB 2018][244]

International Congress of Cell Biology (ICCB) organized by Council of Scientific & Industrial
Research (CSIR) - Centre for Cellular & Molecular Biology (CCMB), From 27th - 31st Jan 2018, in
Hyderabad, India.

## [SYSCON 2017- 18][245]

Society of Young Scientists a National Conference with the theme “Bridging the Gap: Between Basic
and Clinical Research from Bench to Bed Side”. held on 11th &1 2th Jan 2018 at A.I.I.M.S., New
Delhi.

## [NGBT 2017][246]

NextGen Genomics, Biology, Bioinformatics and Technologies (NGBT) Conference held from Oct 2nd – 4th
, 2017 in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India, organized by SciGenom Research Foundation.

## OUR FACILITY

State-of-the-art Laboratory Facility with High end instrumentations including Affymetrix GeneChip
3000 7G Microarray platform, Gene Titan MC high throughput Genotyping Microarray System, Agena
BioScience MassArray System, Amnis ImagestreamX ,   Imaging Flow Cytometer and other small
instruments for Services, Demonstrations and Proof of concept studies by our Application Scientists.

* ## **IMgenius**
  
  #### Accelerating the next generation of biologic drugs
  
  [Section image]
  
  ### Versatile
  
  #### Applies to a wide range of biologics
  
  Soft ionization conditions allow native conformations of biomacromolecules to be studied, e.g.,
  non-covalent protein complexes, high molecular weight aggregates, mRNA, glycoproteins, CRISPR-Cas,
  virus particles, lipid nanoparticles
  
  [Section image]
  
  ### Benchtop
  
  #### Fits easily into your lab
  
  IonDX’s patented ion mobility technology provides powerful analytical characterization in a very
  compact benchtop design.
  
  [Section image]
  
  ### Ion Mobility
  
  #### Operates at atmospheric pressure
  
  IMgenius determines the mobility of a population of molecular ions as they travel through a gas
  under the influence of an electric field. Small ions have higher mobility than larger ions because
  they experience less drag as they travel through a gas.
* ## Enabling a New Level of Ion Mobility Intelligence
  
  ### **MISSION**
  
  **IonDX™ Inc., based in Monterey, CA is commercializing an advanced system to analyze biologic
  drugs. The current biotherapeutic development cost is extremely high, >$2.5B and 8-10 years to
  introduce one of these drugs into the market. Our technology aims to improve analytical quality
  and reduce this cost by implementing a highly informative, fast, and reproducible assay. Our
  patented ion mobility spectrometers can simultaneously measure five important attributes of
  protein-based drugs: drug concentration, purity, stability and structural conformation of these
  molecules. We produce quantitative and correlative measurement in <5 minutes with our bench-top
  instrument. The short time range is rapid enough to introduce it in bioprocess environment where
  other technologies are too slow and unreliable. IonDX’s technology, being amenable to other
  analytical interfaces and automation, can fit into typical biotherapeutic high-throughput
  workflows, providing unique capability to reduce time and effort to bring a biotherapeutic to
  market.**
  
  ### **NSF SBIR AWARDS**
  
  **2019**
  
  **[NSF’s SBIR Phase II][27] awarded to IonDX on Sept 10, 2019 in support of ongoing development of
  our ion mobility spectrometer for macromolecular analysis.**
  
   
  
  **2017**
  
  **[NSF SBIR Phase ][28]I awarded to IonDX for our next-generation stand-alone electrospray ion
  mobility spectrometer.**

  #### Operates at atmospheric pressure
  
  IMgenius determines the mobility of a population of molecular ions as they travel through a gas
  under the influence of an electric field. Small ions have higher mobility than larger ions because
  they experience less drag as they travel through a gas.

  and reduce this cost by implementing a highly informative, fast, and reproducible assay. Our
  patented ion mobility spectrometers can simultaneously measure five important attributes of
  protein-based drugs: drug concentration, purity, stability and structural conformation of these
  molecules. We produce quantitative and correlative measurement in <5 minutes with our bench-top

drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]

[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care.

# Roche LifeScience solutions

[lightcycler in a lab]

## Welcome to a new era of Roche within Life Science

We celebrate the students, the researchers, the managers who work tirelessly in the pursuit of
discovery. By developing the instruments and reagents you rely on each day, we strive to support
your next breakthrough so you can focus on what you do: discovery.

[ Learn more ][23]
Your Partner in Discovery

At Roche we deliver a broad and growing selection of advanced research tools that accelerate life
science discovery. Committed to innovation, quality, and service, we offer an extensive product
portfolio featuring cutting-edge instruments and reagents for genome sequencing, microarray
analysis, nucleic acid purification, real-time PCR, and cell analysis.

We also provide a wealth of valuable resources to support the life science community, including
online technical and application information, convenient on-site product supply programs, and expert
technical and customer service. Through our Industrial Business, we offer specialty biochemicals for
a wide range of industrial applications, as well as custom manufacturing. Explore our comprehensive
products and services and learn how Roche can help you make your next discovery.

## Welcome to a new era of Roche within Life Science

We celebrate the students, the researchers, the managers who work tirelessly in the pursuit of
discovery. By developing the instruments and reagents you rely on each day, we strive to support
your next breakthrough so you can focus on what you do: discovery.

[ Learn more ][23]
Your Partner in Discovery

At Roche we deliver a broad and growing selection of advanced research tools that accelerate life
science discovery. Committed to innovation, quality, and service, we offer an extensive product
portfolio featuring cutting-edge instruments and reagents for genome sequencing, microarray
analysis, nucleic acid purification, real-time PCR, and cell analysis.

We also provide a wealth of valuable resources to support the life science community, including
online technical and application information, convenient on-site product supply programs, and expert
technical and customer service. Through our Industrial Business, we offer specialty biochemicals for
a wide range of industrial applications, as well as custom manufacturing. Explore our comprehensive
products and services and learn how Roche can help you make your next discovery.

## Life Sciences International, Inc. (LSI)** **is an international medtech, biotechnology and
## pharmaceutical expert services company serving all major markets of the world. We provide a
## comprehensive range of market access services from strategy development and analytics for
## reimbursement to clinical programs, health economics, and field advocacy for payer relations and
## clinical science liaison support. We are active in the U.S. across all types of payer
## environments, as well as Western Europe, Eastern Europe, Latin America, Canada, Japan, India,
## Turkey, South Korea, and China.

[
][29]

## WHAT WE DO

At the core of LSI’s value proposition is hands-on experience in managing and achieving results for
client products in the field, among all types of health care payers. We offer services in three
domains:

**Market Advocacy and Payer Relations**
**Market Strategy Development**
**Clinical Support and Health Economics**

[Learn more][30] [›][31] 

[
][32]

## OUR SOLUTIONS 

LSI offers a suite of solutions and services to fit your needs.  Medtech companies looking for
answers about technology and device reimbursement need a team of experts in reimbursement strategies
and payer relations.

[Learn more][33] [›][34]

[
][35]

## OUR COMPANIES 

LSI is designed to provide the structure needed to better support our customers. We provide not only
reimbursement, health economics and payer relations services, but also clinical effectiveness and
utility, clinical delivery integration, clinical trial optimization and medical and clinical science
liaison support to all clients.

[Learn more][36] [›][37]
 

[
[LSI_Brand_R04-25.png]
][38]

## OUR EXPERTISE 

LSI brings together areas of expertise that span virtually all medical disciplines.  Our experience
shows that though reimbursement fundamentals follow unique pathways, they apply to all medical and
surgical disciplines thereby making the reimbursement process as important to understand as the
medical discipline.  

[Learn more][39] [›][40]

[
[LSI_Brand_R04-27.png]
][41]

## OUR REACH 

LSI covers all major global markets, from the United States, to Europe, Latin America, Japan, India,
and China. Our in-country experts are specialized in market access, with both the technical
knowledge and relationship to achieve results.

[Learn more][42] [›][43]

 

[
][44]

## ABOUT US 

LSI works closely with clients to understand how the system works and to navigate the vagaries of
coding, coverage and payment.  Contact us to discuss how LSI can work with you to navigate the
complex reimbursement process in the US and internationally.  

[Learn more][45] [›][46]

[Contact us ›][47]

## Life Sciences International, Inc. (LSI)** **is an international medtech, biotechnology and
## pharmaceutical expert services company serving all major markets of the world. We provide a
## comprehensive range of market access services from strategy development and analytics for
## reimbursement to clinical programs, health economics, and field advocacy for payer relations and
## clinical science liaison support. We are active in the U.S. across all types of payer
## environments, as well as Western Europe, Eastern Europe, Latin America, Canada, Japan, India,
## Turkey, South Korea, and China.

[
][29]

## WHAT WE DO

At the core of LSI’s value proposition is hands-on experience in managing and achieving results for
client products in the field, among all types of health care payers. We offer services in three
domains:

**Market Advocacy and Payer Relations**
**Market Strategy Development**
**Clinical Support and Health Economics**

[Learn more][30] [›][31] 

[
][32]

## OUR SOLUTIONS 

LSI offers a suite of solutions and services to fit your needs.  Medtech companies looking for
answers about technology and device reimbursement need a team of experts in reimbursement strategies
and payer relations.

[Learn more][33] [›][34]

[
][35]

## OUR COMPANIES 

LSI is designed to provide the structure needed to better support our customers. We provide not only
reimbursement, health economics and payer relations services, but also clinical effectiveness and
utility, clinical delivery integration, clinical trial optimization and medical and clinical science
liaison support to all clients.

[Learn more][36] [›][37]
 

[
[LSI_Brand_R04-25.png]
][38]

## OUR EXPERTISE 

LSI brings together areas of expertise that span virtually all medical disciplines.  Our experience
shows that though reimbursement fundamentals follow unique pathways, they apply to all medical and
surgical disciplines thereby making the reimbursement process as important to understand as the
medical discipline.  

[Learn more][39] [›][40]

[
[LSI_Brand_R04-27.png]
][41]

## OUR REACH 

LSI covers all major global markets, from the United States, to Europe, Latin America, Japan, India,
and China. Our in-country experts are specialized in market access, with both the technical
knowledge and relationship to achieve results.

[Learn more][42] [›][43]

 

[
][44]

## ABOUT US 

LSI works closely with clients to understand how the system works and to navigate the vagaries of
coding, coverage and payment.  Contact us to discuss how LSI can work with you to navigate the
complex reimbursement process in the US and internationally.  

[Learn more][45] [›][46]

[Contact us ›][47]

## Who We Are

Because our culture is focused on long-term relationships (with both our clients and our employees),
we are uniquely positioned to solve problems for manufacturers. We are independent and not owned by
an OEM, so we can offer innovative solutions without biases to simply and cost-effectively improve
plant operations. We’ve also built up a wide range of in-house capabilities that fill in the gaps
where other integrators stop short, adding more value and accountability to every project.

###### Our People

At LSI, our core values – service, integrity, and excellence – support our goal to provide the
highest level of benefit in what we do for our customers. Our employees are rewarded for providing
service to the customer first, acting with integrity, and showcasing technical excellence. LSI
employees value hard work and being part of something special.

###### Our Methods

We utilize project execution methodology and metrics tracking to ensure each job’s success. We
always strive for the right application of the proper technology for the purpose required. LSI is
large enough to execute multiple, multi-million dollar projects simultaneously, but small enough to
be responsive to our customers’ needs. We manage each project by focusing on quality, cost, and
schedule. A gap or compromise in any of these three areas will result in projects failing to meet
expectations.

###### Our Reputation

Reputation in the engineering services business is critical to long-term success. LSI knows that we
must excel on every project we do to earn the privilege of being invited back to provide more
services in the future. We depend on repeat business and realize that “we are only as good as our
last project.” We are proud of the fact that our very first customer from 1985 is still an active
and growing customer today.

## Who We Are

Because our culture is focused on long-term relationships (with both our clients and our employees),
we are uniquely positioned to solve problems for manufacturers. We are independent and not owned by
an OEM, so we can offer innovative solutions without biases to simply and cost-effectively improve
plant operations. We’ve also built up a wide range of in-house capabilities that fill in the gaps
where other integrators stop short, adding more value and accountability to every project.

###### Our People

At LSI, our core values – service, integrity, and excellence – support our goal to provide the
highest level of benefit in what we do for our customers. Our employees are rewarded for providing
service to the customer first, acting with integrity, and showcasing technical excellence. LSI
employees value hard work and being part of something special.

###### Our Methods

We utilize project execution methodology and metrics tracking to ensure each job’s success. We
always strive for the right application of the proper technology for the purpose required. LSI is
large enough to execute multiple, multi-million dollar projects simultaneously, but small enough to
be responsive to our customers’ needs. We manage each project by focusing on quality, cost, and
schedule. A gap or compromise in any of these three areas will result in projects failing to meet
expectations.

###### Our Reputation

Reputation in the engineering services business is critical to long-term success. LSI knows that we
must excel on every project we do to earn the privilege of being invited back to provide more
services in the future. We depend on repeat business and realize that “we are only as good as our
last project.” We are proud of the fact that our very first customer from 1985 is still an active
and growing customer today.

### Supplies

Essential everyday laboratory supplies and consumables designed for precision, safety, and
versatility.

*Including: cell culture dishes, PCR plates and tubes, flasks, sterile lab gloves, pipettes, vials,
petri dishes, test tubes, PPE clothing, beakers, filtration, syringe filters, dispensers, graduated
cylinders, and more.*

### Chemicals

High-quality reagents and compounds to power your experiments and assays.

*Including: Biochemicals, PCR/qPCR reagents, assay kits, DNA kits, enzymes, inhibitors, stains,
dyes, substrates, and more.*

[Shop Now][57]

### Equipment

[Read More][58]

Reliable lab equipment and machines built to streamline workflows and maintain consistency.

*Including: Centrifuges, microcentrifuges, environmental chambers, dispensers, electrophoresis,
hotplates, incubators, moisture analyzers, microplate readers/washers, shakers, refrigerators, lab
freezers, lab ovens, fume hoods, stirrers, transilluminators, vortex mixers, and more.*

[Shop Now][59]

### Instruments

[Read More][60]

Smart precision tools for measurement, detection, and analysis across scientific disciplines.

*Including: Analytical balances, lab hydrometers, microscopes, digital refractometers,
spectrophotometers, thermal cyclers, lab thermometers, and more.*

[Shop Now][61]

### Why Shop MIDSCI?

Since 1983, we’ve helped thousands of labs across academia, biotech, government, and private
research get what they need on time, on budget, and with real customer support behind every order.

We bring together:
* **Personalized, expert guidance (you’ll never feel like just an order number)**
* **Responsive service from real humans (no call trees,no bots)**
* **Competitive pricing on trusted brands**
* **Discover our exclusive product lines like PR1MA™ and TTP™ – stocked and distributed by MIDSCI
  and available through our select network of resellers.**
* **Commitment to transparency and long-term lab success**

Whether you’re ordering new products, resolving a backorder, or planning your next big labware
purchase, MIDSCI is here to help every step of the way.

[ About Us ][62]
As a lab, we do a large volume of tissue culture work, and the quality of the plastics that we use
is crucial to our lab's success. We work with a combination of adherent and suspension cells,
ranging from primary cells from mice and human patients to well-known immortalized cell lines. We
have always found TPP has a great design for all of their products (ranging from tissue culture
plates, flasks, and conical tubes). Because of this, we have been purchasing TPP from MIDSCI for as
long as I can remember, and it is one of the most consistent and best purchases that our lab makes.
- Noam, UCSF
I liked the design of the flasks….the neck is way high up so that there is no chance of the media
going is the neck and causing contamination…also the rim around the plates in something I really
liked…really great for holding the plates while doing trypsinization etc….the plates and flasks have
excellent attachment properties and are great for cell culture.
- Piyali Dasgupta - Marhsall University
Thank you for your awesome service! I only wish you carried absolutely everything we need to
purchase, because dealing with our old supplier has become a time-consuming nightmare and their
prices have gotten insane. Really, really appreciate your help!!
- Dean
Many thanks for your help too! It is really nice to have a talented sales rep like you.Please stop
by my lab anytime! I look forward to see you soon." PS: I registered on the web you've sent me!
- Mizuki - University of Kansas

### Large Enough to Deliver, Small Enough to Care.

At MIDSCI™, we’re more than a supplier of laboratory equipment and lab supplies. We’re a trusted
partner to the life science community.

What this means is that our lab consultants are not just processing orders on a day-to-day basis.
They help you **solve problems**, guide purchasing decisions, and ensure your lab runs at its most
efficient. That’s support you just won’t find with larger, big-box distributors.

So whether you’re working in microbiology, biotech, academic research, pharmaceutical, or clinical
research, MIDSCI delivers tailored solutions that enhance functionality, streamline workflows, and
help drive scientific breakthroughs.

to ensure your lab runs at peak efficiency.

### Supplies

versatility.

petri dishes, test tubes, PPE clothing, beakers, filtration, syringe filters, dispensers, graduated
cylinders, and more.*

[Shop Now][61]

Colony Picker makes it look easy. With advanced color imaging, it helps you spot the right colonies
faster. And yes, it fits on your bench or in a hypoxic chamber – because why wouldn’t it? The QPix
FLEX system replaces the clutter with one smart, streamlined system built to move your research
forward.

Imager increase throughput and consistency across cell line development, monoclonal antibody
discovery, and synthetic biology workflows.

throughput and efficiency while reducing human interaction.

### Military Health System Research Symposium (MHSRS) Conference 2026

MTEC will be attending MHSRS! This is the premier military or civilian meeting that focuses
specifically on the unique medical needs of the Warfighter. The event provides a collaborative
setting for the exchange of information between military providers with deployment experience,
research and academic scientists, international partners, and industry on research and related
health care initiatives falling under the topic areas of Combat Casualty Care, Military Operational
Medicine, Clinical and Rehabilitative Medicine, Information Sciences, Military Infectious Diseases,
and the Radiation Health Effects. Learn more at https://www.mhsrs.net/

## AUTOMATION, INSTRUMENTATION, CONTROL PANELS & VALIDATION SOLUTIONS FOR CRITICAL INDUSTRIES

For over 30 years, PACIV has helped biopharmaceutical, medical device, and water & wastewater
industries design, build, automate, and validate the systems that keep critical operations safe,
compliant, and running.

[ [message-sharp-thin-full (1)] CONTACT US ][37]
[b5250d2d]

# What We Do

From field devices to fully compliant systems, PACIV delivers integrated solutions across the entire
project life cycle.

[[Home Page - Process Automation-1]][38]

PLC, SCADA, and DCS system design and integration for reliable process control and monitoring.

[[Home Page - Control Panel Shop Services-1]][39]

Custom UL508A & UL698A certified control panels are engineered, built, and tested for industrial
applications. 

[[Home Page - Instrumentation Services-1]][40]

Installation, calibration, and maintenance of field instruments that measure and control critical
processes. 

[[Home Page - Validation Services-1]][41]
Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) and Computer System Validation (CSV) for FDA, GxP, and
regulatory compliance standards. 

# Industries We Serve

# Why PACIV
* **End-to-End Delivery**
  * From instrumentation to validation, one partner, complete solution.
* **In-House Control Panel Shop**
  * Faster turnaround and higher quality control.
* **Regulatory Expertise**
  * Deep expertise with FDA, GxP, and data integrity.
* **Cross Industry Experience**
  * Proven across life sciences and critical infrastructures.

#### Global Leader in Industrial Automation Solutions

## AUTOMATION, INSTRUMENTATION, CONTROL PANELS & VALIDATION SOLUTIONS FOR CRITICAL INDUSTRIES

For over 30 years, PACIV has helped biopharmaceutical, medical device, and water & wastewater
industries design, build, automate, and validate the systems that keep critical operations safe,
compliant, and running.

[ [message-sharp-thin-full (1)] CONTACT US ][37]
[b5250d2d]

# What We Do

From field devices to fully compliant systems, PACIV delivers integrated solutions across the entire
project life cycle.

[[Home Page - Process Automation-1]][38]

PLC, SCADA, and DCS system design and integration for reliable process control and monitoring.

[[Home Page - Control Panel Shop Services-1]][39]

Custom UL508A & UL698A certified control panels are engineered, built, and tested for industrial
applications. 

[[Home Page - Instrumentation Services-1]][40]

Installation, calibration, and maintenance of field instruments that measure and control critical
processes. 

[[Home Page - Validation Services-1]][41]
Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) and Computer System Validation (CSV) for FDA, GxP, and
regulatory compliance standards. 

# Industries We Serve

# Why PACIV
* **End-to-End Delivery**
  * From instrumentation to validation, one partner, complete solution.
* **In-House Control Panel Shop**
  * Faster turnaround and higher quality control.
* **Regulatory Expertise**
  * Deep expertise with FDA, GxP, and data integrity.
* **Cross Industry Experience**
  * Proven across life sciences and critical infrastructures.

#### Global Leader in Industrial Automation Solutions

## Your Partners in Life Science

### Together we are stronger

PiLS is a non-profit knowledge network created by experts, each with more than a decade of
experience in successful life sciences innovation. Our network is here to offer you advice and
guidance across the entire value chain from idea to product. Our connected companies are then ready
to make your project happen.

By sharing knowledge with each other we streamline your journey, create more value, and get you
where you need to go, faster.

## Who we are

### A comprehensive network of experts and expertise

The PiLS members have broad expertise in a variety of areas that span the life cycle of your
project. Their knowledge and experience is at your disposal.

### A network with a network

By connecting with PiLS you gain access not only to a network of experts, but also to the extended
network of our members within their respective companies and outside. Hospitals, researchers,
investors – all within arm’s reach.

### A network that helps to turn ideas into success

The PiLS experts can give you the information you need to move forward with your project, but they
can also help you to put that information into action.

The PiLS network was originally developed as a way for experts to connect with each other, but it

need to boost their chances for a successful innovation. PiLS can offer what no single expert or

Connecting with PiLS gives you access to our experts, as well as to their extended network: the

through our members.

# Your Trusted Partner in US-Based Contract Manufacturing

Since 1979, Product Resources has been a proven leader of contract manufacturing services delivering
high quality products for industries that demand precision and reliability.

From medical devices to scientific instrumentation to industrial automation, we provide expert
engineering, advanced production capabilities, regulatory compliance and rigorous quality control to
bring your designs to life.

Partner with our engineering and manufacturing teams in Newburyport, Massachusetts, and allow us to
help you meet your exact specifications.

# The Industries We Serve

*We specialize in building technically complex, precision-engineered and highly regulated products
across multiple industries.*

 

## **Medical**
## **Devices**

We deliver high-quality, compliant medical devices with precision manufacturing to drive healthcare
innovation.

[LEARN MORE][51]

## **Bio-Process**
## **Instrumentation**

We manufacture precision instruments for unmatched accuracy, reliability, and performance in
critical research.

[LEARN MORE][52]

## Industrial
## Automation

We enhance automation systems with expert manufacturing, improving efficiency, quality, and
scalability.

[LEARN MORE][53]

For end-product medical device manufacturing, we are an FDA-Registered Facility.
The above industries represent the vast majority of our work, but we also handle projects in other
industries as well.

# The Products We Build

Product Resources has a long history of building complex products and sub-assemblies on behalf of
original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), technical startups and product design firms.

**Here are some of the products we’ve built:**
* High Current Reversable Rectifier
* Microfluidics, Nano-Liter Dispensing
* Polymerization Process Instrument
* Dental Laser Instrument
* Optical Water Toxicity Test Instrument
* Automated Chemistry Lab Equipment
* Pharmaceutical Process Test Equipment
* Custom High Voltage-Current Modulator
* Custom Power Distribution Panels
* Cryogenic Sample Preparation
* Eye Medicine Delivery
* 20kV Arc Drive Power Supply
* Control Panels for Medical Equipment
* IoT Control/Monitoring Equipment
* POS Automated Blending System
* Control System for Robotic-Assisted Surgery
* Surgical Robot Navigation End Effector
* Electromechanical Box Build

[Medical Devices, Scientific Instrumentation, Industrial Automation]

Product Resources provide a full range of manufacturing services that can turn your designs and
prototypes into fully functional, compliant end-products. From Pre-Manufacturing to Manufacturing to
Post-Manufacturing.

Retsch is the leading manufacturer of laboratory mills, jaw crushers and sieving equipment. With

sample preparation and particle size analysis. Trusted by researchers and quality control
laboratories around the world, Retsch products are defined by excellent performance, ease of use,

## About RWD

As a progressive scientific equipment company, RWD introduces the up-to-date laboratory equipment to
the industry including the Laser Speckle Contrast Imaging System, stereotaxic instruments and so on.
Our scientific instruments service is applicable to animal surgery and modeling, neural circuit
signal, cell & molecular biology, microcirculation monitoring, pathological diagnosis, and
veterinary medical science.

Our top-tier research and development team has helped RWD to acquire nearly 100 invention and
utility model patents worldwide, encompassing core technologies in different fields from
neuroscience research, molecular and cellular research, respiration and anesthesia, and to
pathological diagnosis products, and more.

Since 2002, we have been exploring more possibilities in the USA scientific instruments company
sector. Besides, forming partnerships with different enterprises enhances our competitiveness in the
USA scientific equipment company sector.

RWD believes that the scientific instruments USA company sector should take the lead in promoting
continuous learning within the medical science industry. Therefore, apart from being a scientific
instruments service provider, we have established the RWD Academy to share supplementary knowledge
about laboratory technology. We have taken a step ahead of the scientific equipment company USA
sector by organising both online and offline seminars.

## About RWD

As a progressive scientific equipment company, RWD introduces the up-to-date laboratory equipment to
the industry including the Laser Speckle Contrast Imaging System, stereotaxic instruments and so on.
Our scientific instruments service is applicable to animal surgery and modeling, neural circuit
signal, cell & molecular biology, microcirculation monitoring, pathological diagnosis, and
veterinary medical science.

Our top-tier research and development team has helped RWD to acquire nearly 100 invention and
utility model patents worldwide, encompassing core technologies in different fields from
neuroscience research, molecular and cellular research, respiration and anesthesia, and to
pathological diagnosis products, and more.

Since 2002, we have been exploring more possibilities in the USA scientific instruments company
sector. Besides, forming partnerships with different enterprises enhances our competitiveness in the
USA scientific equipment company sector.

RWD believes that the scientific instruments USA company sector should take the lead in promoting
continuous learning within the medical science industry. Therefore, apart from being a scientific
instruments service provider, we have established the RWD Academy to share supplementary knowledge
about laboratory technology. We have taken a step ahead of the scientific equipment company USA
sector by organising both online and offline seminars.

## Product highlights

### **Safe. Gentle. Precise. **

The new Safety-Multifly^{®} PRO combines maximum user safety with a high level of patient comfort.
The semi-automatic safety mechanism activates the needle in the vein, reducing the risk of needle
stick injuries and blood splatter after blood collection, while the ultra-thin-walled needle
supports a high level of patient comfort thanks to reduced insertion force and gentle blood flow.

[
Experience more
][158]
01 / 23

## Business areas

To meet your requirements in medicine and research, we offer a broad product portfolio in the fields
of pre-analysis, life science, laboratory automation and sample transport. The needs of the user are
always at the centre of our solutions.

[ICN Life-Science 1024x1024]

### Life Science

In the areas of liquid handling, cell culture, molecular biology, sample handling and microbiology,
we offer customised solutions of the highest purity and consistent quality. These are specially
designed to ensure reproducibility in analysis. Our products are certified and fulfil the strictest
requirements for research.

[
Life Science
][159]
[ICN Praaeanalytik 1024x1024]

### Preanalytics

For clinics, medical practices and laboratories, we offer a comprehensive range of sample collection
systems and accessories for blood, urine, faeces and saliva. We attach great importance to safety
and efficiency.

[
Preanalytics
][160]
[ICN Probentransport 1024x1024]

### Sample transport

As an essential part of the pre-analytical workflow, our sample transport products ensure the safety
and integrity of your diagnostic samples. We understand the need to safely ship potentially
infectious samples in accordance with clear ADR/RID and IATA dangerous goods regulations to ensure
the protection of all parties involved and to achieve optimal analytical results.

[
Sample transport
][161]
[ICN Labor-Automation 1024x1024]

### Laboratory automation

With our automation solutions, we make laboratory processes in pre-analytics faster, more precise
and more economical. Our many years of experience as a partner in laboratory automation make us a
reliable partner for your needs.

[
Laboratory automation
][162]

## Partners for medicine and research

We believe that tailored innovation and collaborative partnership are the keys to the best possible
healthcare for all. Therefore, we consistently place the needs of medical and research professionals
at the center of our work, just as much as the perspective of patients.

In our pursuit of optimal solutions, we are in close dialogue worldwide with our customers and are
genuinely interested in your needs. For we are convinced that successful partnership leads to mutual
and sustainable growth.

STRATEC designs and manufactures fully automated analyzer systems, software and smart consumables
for OEM partners in the fields of clinical diagnostics and life sciences. Building on an
unparalleled breadth of technology and the expertise gained in more than 45 years of automating
laboratory processes, STRATEC has established itself as one of the world’s leading providers of
automation solutions for in-vitro diagnostics and life science companies. 

Global partners trust STRATEC's exceptional solutions, enabling them to confidently uphold their
commitment to customers and patients. STRATEC covers the entire value chain – from development to
design and production through to quality assurance.

# Provider in Life Science

Since our establishment in 2002, Tailin Bioengineering (Tailin) has been dedicated to technological
innovation and product development across various fields, including biotechnology, ATMPs,
pharmaceutical engineering, radiopharmaceuticals, food safety, water quality, and advanced
materials.
Our primary focus is on delivering a complete range of high-end equipment, precision instruments,
supporting consumables, and services for life science research and industrial applications.

übereinstimmen. Also oben im Fenster von VX Recovery muss das gleiche Datum wie mitte in Feld links
stehen. Das erreicht man indem man im VX Manager unter Lizenzen auf Benz klickt und aktualisiert.
Dann passt das Datum. Und danach funktioniert das Gerät bei alten bis topaktuellen Benzens. Sehr
gut.
